narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Historical Context -> Fact Correction -> Evolution of Product -> Conclusion/CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate the audience about the surprising historical origins of marble soda (Ramune) and its development in Taiwan. It uses a high-energy storytelling format to debunk myths about its invention and explain how soda was once perceived as a remedy during cholera outbreaks. The narrative eventually transitions into the history of Coca-Cola's market entry and the evolution of Taiwan's local beverage industry, ultimately encouraging viewer engagement through comments.
